reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful staff. They are amazing at taking care of their patients.

First time visiting and very professional and friendly staff and excellent price! Everything was explained well and the cat was woken up from the surgery under their care and we received good instructions to go home. The cat also recovered quickly and the surgery went well. The vet even called back and asked how the cat was doing. <3 We will definitely come again!

Professional and friendly care♥️

Easy to come and go, the only downside is the buzzer at the front door. The interior is a bit small and ascetic, but it works.
We got to the doctor within half an hour and received a diagnosis and referral for surgery. It likely saved the family member's life.
Really rude service. Scares people about illnesses and a terrible waste of money.

Very friendly and professional service. It's always a bit uncertain taking your beloved pet to a new clinic, but rest assured Vallila vet has exceptional service and I would absolutely recommend them. Very good atmosphere that the staff care which for me is very important.
Super friendly staff even with our scared dog. Understanding and professional. They can serve also in English. Comes with high recommendations.
Nice, calm atmosphere and nice people.. I left my cat in their care with confidence.

The service is friendly, but it's a shame that you're charged for calls even though you talk to the receptionist and make an appointment. The procedures are expensive anyway, so there shouldn't be a charge for calls.
I have been to VallilaVet with my dog ​​for vaccinations and treatment of minor ailments. Special thanks for how beautifully and gently they have treated my little dog. I recommend it!

Vaccinations and medication are fine.

As for treatment, they then force everything possible on the owner by feeding fear that the situation may be really bad now, and the weak-willed person then agrees to this because they care so much about their pet.

I took my cat to the animal shelter in question because of nausea and vomiting. The diagnosis was that the cat is nauseous and needs to be hydrated, blood and urine tests taken, etc.

I then went home after giving the anti-nausea medication and fed the cat chicken broth with a syringe. Wouldn't it be more honest to offer the anti-nausea medication first and suggest to the owner that they try to hydrate at home with a syringe now that the medication is going to keep it in his stomach? The cat actually recovered in about 4 hours with the chicken broth.

So the reservation was a 30-minute appointment with the vet, which I didn't really get to do, and disappeared somewhere at some point.

Price 175€ for this nonsense, I wouldn't care if I had gotten value for money. Basically, I paid 175€ for giving the cat anti-nausea medication, advice to deworm the cat more often because it goes outside, and a short check-up that left me exhausted by taking the cat's temperature "because of its challenge" even though I was holding the cat and didn't move it much.

This operating model explains the 21 million euro profit for the group in 2021 :)

They performed dental cleaning to my cat without telling me beforehand, and of course they charged me for that. The funny thing is that they had done dental cleaning a few months earlier, and since then I've been brushing my cat's teeth according to their instructions and their recommended toothpaste, and strangely enough she needed dental cleaning so soon??
